say: You didn't know governments can literally create new money.
What if I told you that money can be created out of thin air?
No printing machine. No gold. Just numbers.
Sounds like a magic trick, right?
But this is how part of the modern financial system works.
In many countries, central banks can create new money electronically.
Imagine a central bank wants to put more money into the financial system.
It can buy government bonds from banks or other investors.
No trucks full of cash. No giant printing presses.
Just new money added to the banking system.
Creating more money doesn't automatically make everyone richer.
If spending grows faster than the economy can produce goods and services, prices can rise.
And your money could end up buying less.
So creating money is one thing.
Creating real wealth is something completely different.
You didn't know that about money.
